angles.label: Visits and Calls — Circumstances
angles.description: Examine the studio-apartment visits, late-night calls, and items in the receipts together along the same line of suspicion.

angles.label: Studio-Apartment Visit Route
angles.description: Confirm the time, route, and purpose of his repeated after-work visits to the same studio apartment.

angles.label: Late-Night Calls and Unregistered Numbers
angles.description: Determine what the brief late-night calls and the text thread with an unregistered number actually involved.

angles.label: Items on the Receipts
angles.description: Identify who the women's items and study materials found in the car were actually for.

angles.label: Denying the Affair Suspicion
angles.description: Distinguish whether the studio apartment, the calls, and the items truly point to an affair.

angles.label: Why It Was Hidden
angles.description: Examine why the visits, calls, and items were never explained to his spouse.

angles.label: Large Cash Withdrawal — Circumstances
angles.description: Examine the large withdrawal from a personal account, the cash movement, and the exclusion of the spouse from the decision.

angles.label: 30-Million-Won Cash Withdrawal
angles.description: Confirm the timing and method by which 30 million won was pulled in cash from a separate account in Lee Jun-ho's name over the past four months.

angles.label: Boundary Between Personal Funds and Marital Assets
angles.description: Separate whether the source of the withdrawal was the joint savings or a personal account, and isolate the responsibility for not telling the spouse.

angles.label: Recipient of the Cash and the Reason
angles.description: Determine who received the cash and under what circumstances it was handed over.

angles.label: Spousal Consent Excluded
angles.description: Even if the money was personal, examine the responsibility of moving a large sum without consulting the spouse.

angles.label: Savings and Transfer — Circumstances
angles.description: Examine in order: the cancellation of the joint savings, the authorization paperwork, the transfer to the investment group, and how it was lost.

angles.label: Joint Savings Cancellation
angles.description: Confirm when and on whose application the joint savings were cancelled.

angles.label: Authorization Form and Signature
angles.description: Examine how the signature on the authorization form was produced and whether actual consent was given.

angles.label: How the Money Reached the Investment Group
angles.description: Trace how the cancelled funds flowed into the investment group, and how the membership was joined.

angles.label: Loss and Legal Responsibility
angles.description: Separate the outcome of the money being lost and the responsibility for the document handling from any emotional claim of victimhood.

angles.label: Order of Responsibility
angles.description: Do not bundle concealment, account checking, money movement, and document violations into one — keep them separate.

angles.label: Where the Concealment Began
angles.description: Examine who hid what first, and keep the act of hiding separate from the act of moving money.

angles.label: Where the Account Checking Began
angles.description: Confirm when Park Ji-yeon began looking into the account, and the responsibility that comes with that act.

angles.label: Timing of the Money Movements
angles.description: Lay out, in order, Lee Jun-ho's cash withdrawals and Park Ji-yeon's joint-savings cancellation and transfer.

angles.label: Where the Legal Line Was Crossed
angles.description: Apart from motive, separate out the document handling and money movement that carry legal responsibility.

angles.label: Separated Record of Responsibility
angles.description: Not which side is worse, but a separate record of concealment, monitoring, execution, and unlawfulness.
